46709-memoirs-of-joseph-grimaldi.title: Memoirs Of Joseph Grimaldi
46709-memoirs-of-joseph-grimaldi.creator: Unknown
46709-memoirs-of-joseph-grimaldi.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Nor were our speculations confined to Clowns alone: they extended to Harlequins, Pantaloons, and Columbines, all of whom we believed to be real and veritable personages, existing in the same forms and characters all the year round. How often have we wished that the Pantaloon were our god-father! and how often thought that to marry a Columbine would be to attain the highest pitch of all human felicity!

493-falk-a-reminiscence.title: Falk A Reminiscence
493-falk-a-reminiscence.creator: Joseph Conrad
493-falk-a-reminiscence.description: A book by Joseph Conrad. The sea never changes, and its works for all the talk of men are wrapped in mystery. But we agreed that the times were changed. And we talked of old ships, of sea-accidents, of break-downs, dismastings; and of a man who brought his ship safe to Liverpool all the way from the River Platte under a jury rudder.

arxiv-1908-07769.title: Efficient and flexible simulation-based sample size determination for clinical trials with multiple design parameters
arxiv-1908-07769.creator: Duncan T. Wilson, Rebecca E. A. Walwyn, Richard Hooper, Julia Brown, Amanda J. Farrin
arxiv-1908-07769.description: Abstract Simulation offers a simple and flexible way to estimate the power of a clinical trial when analytic formulae are not available. The computational burden of using simulation has, however, restricted its application to only the simplest of sample size determination problems, minimising a single parameter (the overall sample size) subject to power being above a target level.

arxiv-2210-07023.title: Phase-matched locally chiral light for global control of chiral light-matter interaction Journal: opticajournal
arxiv-2210-07023.creator: Chong Ye, Yifan Sun, Libin Fu, Xiangdong Zhang
arxiv-2210-07023.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Chong Ye, Yifan Sun, Libin Fu, Xiangdong Zhang. Locally chiral light is an emerging tool for probing and controlling molecular chirality. It can generate large and freely adjustable enantioselectivities in purely electric-dipole effects, offering its major advantages over traditional chiral light. However, the existing types of locally chiral light are phase-mismatched, and thus the global efficiencies are greatly reduced compared with the maximum single-point efficiencies or even vanish. Here, we propose a scheme to generate phase-matched locally chiral light.

arxiv-2307-13715.title: Team Intro_to_AI_team8 at CoachAI Badminton Challenge 2023: Advanced ShuttleNet for Shot Predictions
arxiv-2307-13715.creator: Shih-Hong Chen, Pin-Hsuan Chou, Yong-Fu Liu, Chien-An Han
arxiv-2307-13715.description: Abstract In this paper, our objective is to improve the performance of the existing framework ShuttleNet in predicting badminton shot types and locations by leveraging past strokes. We participated in the CoachAI Badminton Challenge at IJCAI 2023 and achieved significantly better results compared to the baseline.

arxiv-2310-00878.title: The generalized 4-connectivity of burnt pancake graphs
arxiv-2310-00878.description: Abstract Abstract The generalized k -connectivity of a graph G , denoted by \kappa_{k}(G) , is the minimum number of internally edge disjoint S -trees for any S\subseteq V(G) and |S|=k . The generalized k -connectivity is a natural extension of the classical connectivity and plays a key role in applications related to the modern interconnection networks.

arxiv-2312-11557.title: SAI3D: Segment Any Instance in 3D Scenes
arxiv-2312-11557.creator: Yingda Yin, Yuzheng Liu, Yang Xiao, Daniel Cohen-Or, Jingwei Huang, Baoquan Chen
arxiv-2312-11557.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yingda Yin, Yuzheng Liu, Yang Xiao, Daniel Cohen-Or, Jingwei Huang, Baoquan Chen. Advancements in 3D instance segmentation have traditionally been tethered to the availability of annotated datasets, limiting their application to a narrow spectrum of object categories. Recent efforts have sought to harness vision-language models like CLIP for open-set semantic reasoning, yet these methods struggle to distinguish between objects of the same categories and rely on specific prompts that are not universally applicable.

arxiv-2312-14631.title: Extrapolating semileptonic form factors using Bayesian-inference fits regulated by unitarity and analyticity
arxiv-2312-14631.creator: J.T. Tsang
arxiv-2312-14631.description: Abstract We discuss our recently proposed [ 1 ] model-independent framework for fitting hadronic form-factor data, which are often only available at discrete kinematical points, using parameterisations based on unitarity and analyticity. The accompanying dispersive bound on the form factors (unitarity constraint) is used to regulate the ill-posed fitting problem and allow model-independent predictions over the entire physical range.

arxiv-2402-12017.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alon Eden, Michal Feldman, Simon Mauras, Divyarthi Mohan. We study auction design within the widely acclaimed model of interdependent values, introduced by Milgrom and Weber [1982]. In this model, every bidder i i has a private signal s i s_{i} for the item for sale, and a public valuation function v i ​ ( s 1 , … , s n ) v_{i}(s_{1},\ldots,s_{n}) which maps every vector of private signals (of all bidders) into a real value.

arxiv-2403-12557.title: Numerical approximation of a class of constrained Hamilton-Jacobi equations
arxiv-2403-12557.creator: Benoît Gaudeul, Hélène Hivert
arxiv-2403-12557.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce a framework for the discretization of a class of constrained Hamilton-Jacobi equations, a system coupling a Hamilton-Jacobi equation with a Lagrange multiplier determined by the constraint. The equation is non-local, and the constraint has bounded variations.

arxiv-2507-00933.title: A first look at rocky exoplanets with JWST
arxiv-2507-00933.creator: Laura Kreidberg, Kevin B. Stevenson
arxiv-2507-00933.description: Abstract Rocky exoplanet characterization has been a top priority for early James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) science operations. Several milestones have been achieved, including the most precise rocky planet transmission spectra measured to date, and the first detection of thermal emission for rocky worlds below 800 Kelvin. Despite these advances, no atmospheres have been definitively detected.

arxiv-2507-17263.title: Fingerprints of collective magnetic excitations in inelastic electron tunneling spectroscopy
arxiv-2507-17263.creator: F. Rist, H. L. Nourse, B. J. Powell
arxiv-2507-17263.description: Abstract Spin-flip inelastic electron tunneling spectroscopy allows magnetic materials to be probed at the single-atom level via scanning tunneling microscopy. Previously, the local spectral weight of spin excitations of small systems has been deduced from discrete steps in the differential conductance. However, this is not viable for large systems.

arxiv-2602-02762.title: On the Sample Efficiency of Inverse Dynamics Models for Semi-Supervised Imitation Learning
arxiv-2602-02762.creator: Sacha Morin, Moonsub Byeon, Alexia Jolicoeur-Martineau, Sébastien Lachapelle
arxiv-2602-02762.description: Abstract Semi-supervised imitation learning (SSIL) consists in learning a policy from a small dataset of action-labeled trajectories and a much larger dataset of action-free trajectories. Some SSIL methods learn an inverse dynamics model (IDM) to predict the action from the current state and the next state.

pmc-12671816.title: Leprosy perceptions and health seeking behaviour in Miandrivazo district, Madagascar
pmc-12671816.creator: Hanitriniaina Rasolofozafy, Maya Ronse, Lovasoa Mbolamanana Joseph Andrianiriana, Randrianatoandro Andriamira, Epco Hasker, Bouke Catherine de Jong, Bertrand Cauchoix, Stéphanie Ramboarina, Charlotte Gryseels, Koen Peeters Grietens
pmc-12671816.description: BackgroundLeprosy remains a severe health and social problem in several low- and middle-income countries, with two main challenges: late diagnosis, which can lead to disabilities, and the burden of stigma and social exclusion. This study explored socio-cultural factors, including community perceptions and representations of leprosy, influencing access to and uptake of biomedical care in an endemic district of Madagascar.

pmc-13120612.title: Twelve Weeks of In-Season Strength Training at Moderate Intensities Improve Strength and Body Composition Without Increasing Muscle Damage or Inflammation in Elite Young Female Soccer Players
pmc-13120612.creator: Mariem Bousselmi, Amira Ben Moussa Zouita, Manel Darragi, Houssem M. Karamti, Sghaeir Zouita, Juan Del Coso, Ahlem Ben Hmid, Anthony C. Hackney, Urs Granacher, Hassane Zouhal
pmc-13120612.description: Strength training (ST) is commonly implemented to enhance soccer-related fitness qualities such as sprinting, jumping, and changes-of-direction while also contributing to injury risk reduction. It is traditionally emphasized in the pre-season period. In-season ST may confer these benefits, but it can also induce muscle damage and inflammation.

pmc-13233958.title: Advances in silicon carbide pressure sensors for high-temperature extreme environment sensing
pmc-13233958.creator: Chen Wu, Xudong Fang, Hao Sun, Zhongkai Zhang, Meng Shi, Zhaojun Liu, Ziyan Fang, Yuefei Yan, Qiang Kang, Ryutaro Maeda, Bian Tian, Libo Zhao, Zhuangde Jiang
pmc-13233958.description: In fields such as aerospace, geothermal energy, Venus exploration, and nuclear power safety, large-scale equipment often operates under extreme conditions characterized by high temperatures, radiation, corrosive gases, and vibration. Pressure monitoring at critical locations is essential for equipment condition monitoring, fault diagnosis, and improving operational efficiency.
